blocks.title: Card Guardians
blocks.subtitle: Creative Ad
blocks.clientQuote: "Welcome to the world of Valentia! Build your deck of cards and prepare for strategic battles against monsters and the Guardians of Chaos."

blocks.body:
Card Guardians needed an engaging App Preview video to boost performance in paid ad campaigns. The goal was increase CTR (clickthrough rate).

The audience consisted mostly of male players aged 21-34, fans of RPG and strategy mechanics, motivated by mastery, skill improvement, and tactical depth.

​**The Approach**

To stand out in crowded mobile game ads, the focus was in combining authentic gameplay with cinematic visual effects. The hypothesis was that fast-paced editing, dynamic camera cuts, and synchronized VFX/SFX paired with an epic soundtrack would amplify the excitement and communicate the game’s strategic intensity.​

**The Result**​

The final motion was designed in multiple formats (vertical, horizontal and square) for Google Ads, Meta Ads and App Stores, all under 30 seconds.  
Every element was tuned to capture attention in the first seconds, showcase progression, and convey the game’s epic scale.

After the success of earlier campaigns, Card Guardians sought to optimize ad performance by merging two proven creative directions: a well-performing video ad and the visual mood of a indie card-based game.  
The goal remained the same (increase CTR), but with the challenge to bring a twist to a familiar ad format, making it more emotionally engaging and memorable for RPG and card-strategy fans.

​**The Approach**

**​**The creative focus was on strategic decision-making, showing moments where the player’s poor card choices lead to defeat.

Each sequence was built and animated in After Effects with refined timing curves, expressions, and bounce animations to give the cards a tactile feel, while applying CRT textures and retro-inspired lighting to reinforce the nostalgic aesthetic.

**The Result**

​A 30-second video ad formatted for multiple platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, and mobile stores) combining tension, strategy, and nostalgia.

The final piece created a compelling contrast between player error and mastery, driving higher engagement and stronger curiosity to play.

blocks.title: Everyday Puzzles - Only a Genius
blocks.subtitle: Creative Ad
blocks.clientQuote: "Multiple Games in One App! A hub of word puzzles and brain teasers to keep you entertained daily!"

blocks.body:
**The Challenge**

​Drive CTR and CVR for a puzzle game targeting a younger audience: a competitive space where we need to grab attention fast.

**​The Approach**

The ad provokes the viewer directly and dares them to prove otherwise. Bold colors and original character design kept the visual energy high while the psychological hook did the conversion work.

**The Result**

The ad became the top performer of numerous campaigns and held that position for months, delivering high-value paying users with incredible ROAS.

Localized into 10 languages and adapted into 4 formats for all major ad platforms.

blocks.title: LunaCross App Preview
blocks.clientQuote: "Crossword, trivia, and anagrams - that's LunaCross. A fun word spelling game!"

blocks.body: This App Preview was designed to make LunaCross stand out in the App and Play Stores, turning curiosity into downloads. Strong ASO visuals can double conversion rates and significantly grow revenue for mobile word and puzzle games.

The storyboard process began with close collaboration with the product managers to define which gameplay features and moments would best represent LunaCross. Key visuals were created to highlight the most engaging interactions and user experiences. The copywriting was carefully planned to deliver clear, compelling messages that captured the spirit of the game while optimizing viewer engagement throughout the preview.

# **App Stores**

### The app preview was adapted to meet both Apple App Store and Google Play Store requirements.

Each version follows the platform’s specific dimensions, aspect ratios, and duration limits, ensuring optimal visual quality and performance.

blocks.title: Pet Shop Fever
blocks.subtitle: UA Motion Design
blocks.clientQuote:
"Run your own pet hotel and petshop! 
Care for cats, dogs, bunnies, birds, and more in this heartwarming animal game!"

blocks.body:
**The Challenge**

Drive higher CTR for a mobile game targeting women 35-44, an audience motivated by collection, emotional connection, and mastery.​​

**The Approach** 

I've designed a 30-second video around authentic gameplay moments - pet variety, shop management flow and emotional triggers - to build connection with the target audience. ​​

**The Result​**

A multi-ratio video adapted for Google Ads, Meta Ads, and App Stores - translating the game's core experience into a conversion-focused creative.

**The Challenge​**

Announce a major content update: new environments, pets, and workstations - with a paid ad that would hold attention.​

**The Approach​**

Built a fun mini-narrative instead of a standard gameplay montage. Structured the pacing around contrast: a calm opening that breaks into humor and chaos.

**The Result​**

30-second multi-platform ad that turned a feature announcement into a short animated story - driving anticipation and re-engagement with the game's world.
A Walk-Cycle study starring the socialite Talita.
This project's challenge was to design a character who conveys her whole personality through simply shapes and colors. Someone who was preppy, elegante and enjoyed a good glass of wine.

projects.title: Party In My Dorm - Creative Ad

blocks.title: Party In My Dorm
blocks.subtitle: Creative Ad
blocks.clientQuote: Virtually connect with your crew in an exciting student simulator! Throw a house party, collect exclusive swag, style your look, or just chill with your besties.

blocks.body:
Party In My Dorm needed a short, story-driven ad to test creative direction for paid UA campaigns. The goal was to hook viewers in the first seconds and drive downloads.  

**The Approach**

The script was broken into four beats: a dramatic hook, a makeover, a dorm upgrade, and a social payoff, each staged as its own scene with a distinct color mood so the shift reads even with the sound off. All character art and assets stayed inside PIMD's existing illustrated style, animated through camera movement, timing, and kinetic type.

**The Result**

A 15-second vertical piece paced for retention on mobile, built to prove out a fast, emotionally-driven format PIMD could scale across future UA creative.

blocks.title: Everyday Puzzles - Mental IQ
blocks.subtitle: Creative Ad
blocks.clientQuote: "Multiple Games in One App! A hub of word puzzles and brain teasers to keep you entertained daily!"

blocks.body:
**The Challenge**  
Drive installs for a word-puzzle app in a feed saturated with lookalike crossword ads, where a straightforward gameplay demo gets scrolled past in under a second.

**The Approach**  
The ad turns the clue itself into the hook: a real pop-culture reference paired with a fake IQ counter. A playful, hand-drawn cursor against the clean app UI made the mechanic instantly readable.

**The Result**  
The ad delivered well and held up across placements. Adapted into 4 main formats for the major ad platforms, and localized across several countries with pop culture clues tailored to each region's audience.
